title: RiskProduct API canonical envelope
description: Envelope wrapping every API response. Every response under /api/v1.6.0/ MUST validate against this schema. The `data` field's shape varies per endpoint (protocols, factors, hacks, incidents, rubric).

data_as_of.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the most recent factor_score collected_at across the response payload. May be the unix epoch when no scores have been collected yet.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when this dump ran.
